ticket.title: Lock the complete artifact and safety contract

criteria.text: The integrated Play supports multiple explicit criteria and independent commands against clean, tracked-dirty, and approved-untracked proof subjects.
criteria.raw: - [ ] The integrated Play supports multiple explicit criteria and independent commands against clean, tracked-dirty, and approved-untracked proof subjects.

criteria.text: The shareable JSON field names, enum values, nullability, ordering, and schema version form a documented compatibility contract.
criteria.raw: - [ ] The shareable JSON field names, enum values, nullability, ordering, and schema version form a documented compatibility contract.

criteria.text: Digest inputs use RFC 8785 canonical JSON.
criteria.raw: - [ ] Digest inputs use RFC 8785 canonical JSON.

criteria.text: The code fingerprint contains no execution-environment field.
criteria.raw: - [ ] The code fingerprint contains no execution-environment field.

criteria.text: The proof seal contains the stable fields listed in parent issue #1 and no other fields.
criteria.raw: - [ ] The proof seal contains the stable fields listed in parent issue #1 and no other fields.

criteria.text: Equivalent proof subjects, approved plans, environments, and outcomes produce identical JSON facts and proof seals apart from documented presentation timestamps and durations.
criteria.raw: - [ ] Equivalent proof subjects, approved plans, environments, and outcomes produce identical JSON facts and proof seals apart from documented presentation timestamps and durations.

criteria.text: Changes to criteria, fingerprint, plan, stable environment, command outcome, criterion status, overall status, or material warning code change the seal.
criteria.raw: - [ ] Changes to criteria, fingerprint, plan, stable environment, command outcome, criterion status, overall status, or material warning code change the seal.

criteria.text: Stdout, stderr, timestamps, durations, run IDs, absolute paths, temporary paths, and formatting changes do not change the seal.
criteria.raw: - [ ] Stdout, stderr, timestamps, durations, run IDs, absolute paths, temporary paths, and formatting changes do not change the seal.

criteria.text: Exact checkout and snapshot paths are absent from JSON, cards, seals, warnings, and errors.
criteria.raw: - [ ] Exact checkout and snapshot paths are absent from JSON, cards, seals, warnings, and errors.

criteria.text: Credential fixtures are rendered only as `<redacted>`.
criteria.raw: - [ ] Credential fixtures are rendered only as `<redacted>`.

criteria.text: No untracked-file content appears in a persisted artifact.
criteria.raw: - [ ] No untracked-file content appears in a persisted artifact.

criteria.text: Text output limits, proof-card excerpt limits, binary-output replacement, and warning codes match parent issue #1 exactly.
criteria.raw: - [ ] Text output limits, proof-card excerpt limits, binary-output replacement, and warning codes match parent issue #1 exactly.

criteria.text: `FINGERPRINT_INCOMPLETE`, `OUTPUT_TRUNCATED`, `VALUE_REDACTED`, and `BINARY_OUTPUT_OMITTED` appear as stable codes rather than inferred prose.
criteria.raw: - [ ] `FINGERPRINT_INCOMPLETE`, `OUTPUT_TRUNCATED`, `VALUE_REDACTED`, and `BINARY_OUTPUT_OMITTED` appear as stable codes rather than inferred prose.

criteria.text: Run errors produce no overall status or seal.
criteria.raw: - [ ] Run errors produce no overall status or seal.

criteria.text: The complete Play-run seam covers one composed clean run, one composed dirty run, equivalent repeats, changed proof facts, masked output, truncated output, binary output, incomplete fingerprint, policy failure, and source mutation.
criteria.raw: - [ ] The complete Play-run seam covers one composed clean run, one composed dirty run, equivalent repeats, changed proof facts, masked output, truncated output, binary output, incomplete fingerprint, policy failure, and source mutation.

criteria.text: A traceability table maps every mandatory 0.1 parent requirement to an acceptance test in #2, #3, #4, or #5, or to a composed assertion in this ticket.
criteria.raw: - [ ] A traceability table maps every mandatory 0.1 parent requirement to an acceptance test in #2, #3, #4, or #5, or to a composed assertion in this ticket.

criteria.text: If traceability finds missing behavior or missing tests, record the exact gap and create a separate `ready-for-agent` gap ticket with the appropriate native blocking relationship.
criteria.raw: - [ ] If traceability finds missing behavior or missing tests, record the exact gap and create a separate `ready-for-agent` gap ticket with the appropriate native blocking relationship.

criteria.text: This ticket stops and remains blocked until every such gap ticket is closed.
criteria.raw: - [ ] This ticket stops and remains blocked until every such gap ticket is closed.

criteria.text: This ticket must not absorb or implement missing feature behavior itself.
criteria.raw: - [ ] This ticket must not absorb or implement missing feature behavior itself.

criteria.text: No criteria generation, command graph, output extraction, static evidence, manual evidence, GitHub comment, private-repository, non-Node, or cross-run reuse behavior is added.
